title_candidates: DiffusionGemma trades normal text generation for speed
summary: Google released DiffusionGemma, an experimental Apache 2.0 open model that generates text in blocks and can run up to four times faster on dedicated GPUs.

primary_source.title: DiffusionGemma: 4x faster text generation
primary_source.author: Google DeepMind
key_facts: DiffusionGemma is a 26B mixture-of-experts model using diffusion-style text generation.
Google says the model can run up to four times faster on dedicated GPUs.
The model is released under the Apache 2.0 license for experimentation.

prerequisites: A computer or cloud notebook with access to a supported GPU
A willingness to test experimental model quality

steps.instruction: Run the same prompts through DiffusionGemma and your default model, then compare response time and edit burden.

risk_flags: Experimental speed claims should be tested against user-specific prompts and hardware.
